items.text: Fixed shore vector calculations around the boat building station on the Tropical2 map, improving boat placement and navigation near the shore.
Extended and refined monument ladders and corrected water entry points, making ladder climbing smoother and preventing accidental water entry.
Fixed door controllers becoming unpaired when a door is re‑skinned, ensuring doors continue to work after cosmetic changes.
Resolved multiple train network issues: tunnel entrances now spawn only where stations fit, stations avoid canyon blockers, and above‑ground ramps no longer create disconnected paths.
Fixed the Recycle Bin UI so dragging an item onto the workbench upgrade correctly swaps the item instead of showing an erroneous "Container does not accept player items!" message.
Fixed catapult projectile clipping off the map, restoring proper projectile behavior.
Added hotbar action progress indicators and aligned third‑person reload animations for clearer feedback during weapon use.
Resolved invisible building block bug, ensuring all placed structures are visible to players.

Refined extraction mission interactions: added hold‑E mission mechanics with movement/camera lock, delayed ledger reads (5 s) and deferred material consumption until completion, expanded mission card UI, and preserved safe‑pocket items when loading backpacks.
Improved loot reveal flow: first loot item now appears automatically and hotbar outlines are disabled for a cleaner UI during extraction missions.
Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, emit dodgeable charges dealing 55 damage, and can strike mid‑fight, adding new tactical options.
Raids will no longer crash; the game now refuses to start a raid without a valid raid map, preventing errors and improving stability.
Improved third-person combat visuals: removed first-person weapon shake when in third-person and fixed attack alignment, making attacks feel more accurate.
Added a reload progress bar next to the weapon in shoulder camera, giving clear feedback on reload timing.

2026-11-16.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

2026-11-15.summary:
### Missions & Interactions
- Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.

### Drones
- Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.

### Raiding
- Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.

### NPC & AI
- A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.

### Loot & UI
- Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

Each enemy type now drops its own unique reward, including monument guards.
